footnotes.text: 3. DANC 150, 281, and 282 fulfill the College of Arts and Sciences’ nine hours of Humanities or Fine requirements.

footnotes.text: 4. Choose either the ballet or contemporary dance track. Ballet requires 8 ballet techniques (3 courses must be taken for 2 credit hours each) and 4 contemporary techniques. Contemporary dance requires 6 contemporary techniques (3 courses must be taken for 2 credit hours each), 4 ballet techniques, and 2 techniques of other forms of dance. Students must meet both the number of credits and distribution of technique requirements listed. Some techniques courses are variable credit. To graduate with a major in dance, students must successfully complete DANC 302 and DANC 312. Students may take up to 24 hours of techniques courses toward the major.
